caption: The drawing features a bird’s-eye view of a landscape plan. At the top center, there is a large red X-shaped building surrounded by a yellow circular border, with smaller pathways and green lawns filling the space around it. Radiating from the building are rows of small green trees or shrubs forming a partial oval. Below this area, there are various patches of green fields, including a grid-like arrangement of rectangular and irregular plots with different colors indicating different crops or plants (shades of green, light brown, tan, purple, and yellow). Two smaller red rectangular buildings appear on the left and right sides, while the fields form a heart-like polygon in the middle lower part of the image. The lower section is bordered by a triangular, dark green forest with tall trees, transitioning to a blue and lavender shaded terrain at the bottom. Roadways and walkways, colored light brown or white, weave throughout the property and connect the buildings. The river or water feature borders the bottom right area, drawn in blue and white. The border of the image includes the text, “THE ANDREW M. FERRIS ESTATE - THE BLACKWELL SURVEY 1860.”
title: A. M. Ferris Estate
